AnFerrr/Second-Screen-Display-Linux
Second Screen Display Linux
Brillcrafter/(AnFer)
Allows you to display HudLcd in a separate window
This plugin allows you to move all the HudLcd items into a separate window that you can do whatever with. To Activate the screen, use the command "/ssd open" and you can close it whenever. It defaults to removing the HudLcd display and placing it on the first screen but you can control whether; it removes the display, duplicates it or just ignores it and which screen the HudLcd is put on. You can do this by adding two extra options to the HudLcd config string, resulting in "hudlcd:{PosX}:{PosY}:{Fontsize}:{Colour}:{Shadow}:{Remove}:{ScreenID}" {remove} has 3 options, "remove", "duplicate", "ignore" {ScreenID} is the (integer) ID of the window you want it displayed on.
